prerequisites: Punch list items < 10% open per system
activities.procedure_required: Pre-commissioning procedure per system (MCP-001 to MCP-020)
activities.safety_hold_point: LOTO applied; permit-to-work in place; system isolated from live systems
activities.acceptance_criteria: Mechanical completion certificate signed by commissioning engineer and EPC contractor

activities.procedure_required: Hydrotest procedure per piping class (HT-001 to HT-015)
activities.safety_hold_point: Pressure test area barricaded; personnel cleared; test pressure < 110% design
activities.acceptance_criteria: No leaks at test pressure held for 30 minutes; test certified per ASME B31.3

prerequisites: Blinding/spool removal for flushing path established
activities.procedure_required: Flushing procedure (FL-001) and chemical cleaning specification (CC-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical handling PPE; waste collection and neutralisation plan confirmed
activities.acceptance_criteria: Flush water clarity within specification; chemical cleaning passivation verified by coupon

activities.safety_hold_point: ESD loops verified by independent party before connecting to final elements
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% of loops checked; signal range, direction, and accuracy within tolerance

activities.activity: Electrical megger check and motor solo run
prerequisites: MCC breaker and protection settings verified
activities.safety_hold_point: Coupling disconnected; area cleared; emergency stop verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Insulation resistance > 1 MΩ/kV; vibration < 4 mm/s; current balanced across phases

activities.safety_hold_point: SIS validation witnessed by HSE manager; bypass management in place
activities.acceptance_criteria: All control loops, interlock logic, alarm setpoints, and HMI graphics verified per C&E matrix

activities.safety_hold_point: False alarm prevention plan in place during construction
activities.acceptance_criteria: All detectors calibrated; cause-and-effect logic verified; release system activated in test

prerequisites: Final elements (valves, vents, dampers) in place
activities.safety_hold_point: Critical ESD functions tested one at a time; all bypasses removed after test
activities.acceptance_criteria: All shutdown levels (plant, unit, equipment) functional; response time within specification

prerequisites: Refractory installation completed and cured minimum 72 hours
activities.procedure_required: Refractory dry-out schedule from refractory supplier (RD-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Temperature ramp rate strictly per supplier curve; personnel excluded during heating
activities.acceptance_criteria: Temperature profile across all zones within supplier tolerance; no steam observed at vents

activities.safety_hold_point: Reactor atmosphere inerted; oxygen < 1%; personnel in full PPE; bed-level verification after each fill
activities.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst loaded to bed depth within ±10 mm; no bridging; pressure drop within spec

prerequisites: Conveyors, elevators, feed system mechanically complete
activities.safety_hold_point: Emergency stops tested; guards in place; area cleared of personnel
activities.acceptance_criteria: Sustained operation at design rate for 4 hours with surrogate material; no plugging

activities.safety_hold_point: Gasifier isolated from syngas path during initial trials
activities.acceptance_criteria: Graduated feed rate from 10% to 100% design without plugging or bridging

activities.safety_hold_point: All personnel non-essential cleared from gasifier area; continuous CO/H2 monitoring active
activities.acceptance_criteria: Gasifier bed temperature at target range; refractory heat-up ramp rate within spec

activities.safety_hold_point: Flare pilot confirmed lit before syngas diversion; CO/H2 detectors active
activities.acceptance_criteria: Syngas flow and composition at design conditions; tar and particulates within expected range

activities.safety_hold_point: All acid gas removal solvent filled; guard bed pre-conditioned
activities.acceptance_criteria: Outlet gas meets methanol synthesis inlet spec: tar < 50 mg/Nm3, S < 0.1 ppmv, Cl < 1 ppmv

activities.activity: Methanol synthesis loop start-up and catalyst reduction
prerequisites: Catalyst loaded and protected with inert
activities.procedure_required: Loops start-up and catalyst reduction procedure from licensor (MS-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Catalyst reduction temperature ramp strictly per licensor curve; hydrogen concentration controlled
activities.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst fully reduced (verified by water formation); loop pressurised to operating conditions

activities.safety_hold_point: Methanol detection in area; loading ground bonding verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Stable methanol production at minimum 50% design rate; loop temperature and pressure steady

prerequisites: Methanol at required pressure and flow
activities.safety_hold_point: All vents routed to flare/vapour recovery; pressure relief valves verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Column pressure, temperature, and reflux ratio at operating targets

prerequisites: Lab GC and Karl Fischer analyser calibrated
activities.safety_hold_point: Off-spec methanol routed to slop/recycle; on-spec product accepted to storage only after lab clearance
activities.acceptance_criteria: Product methanol meets IMPCA spec (min 99.85 wt% methanol, ethanol < 50 ppm, water < 500 ppm)

prerequisites: Feedstock inventory sufficient for test duration
activities.procedure_required: Performance test procedure per EPC contract (PT-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Test run requires full management approval; standby team ready for intervention
activities.acceptance_criteria: Guaranteed parameters met: capacity, biomass consumption, utility consumption, methanol purity, emissions limits

prerequisites: Methanol storage tank at operating level
activities.safety_hold_point: Grounding system verified; emergency stop function tested; vapour recovery confirmed
activities.acceptance_criteria: Loading rate within design; vapour recovery efficiency verified; no leak detected

prerequisites: Stack testing platform and ports available
activities.procedure_required: Emissions monitoring protocol per permit conditions (EM-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: Testing at elevated heights; fall protection required; confined space entry for stack if needed
activities.acceptance_criteria: All stack emissions within permit limits; fugitive emissions program completed

activities.procedure_required: Operator training program per operations manual (TR-001)
activities.safety_hold_point: No operator assigned to shift duty without written competency sign-off
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% of operations personnel assessed as competent for their role
